messages:
harper: Quick follow-up to the all-hands finance block  a couple of product teams asked for a super-short decision matrix: when to use p-card vs PO vs prepay vs reserve. Can we get a one-pager?

maria: Sure. Quick rules here in-thread: p-card = low-risk purchases, single txn <= $2k, monthly card cap default $5k. PO/invoice for one-off vendor invoices > $5k. Prepay/multi-year commits = procurement + legal + FP&A review (usually >$25k).

noah: Who can sign off on exceptions if a manager needs a higher p-card limit temporarily?

vp_finance: Delegation: managers can request temporary increases up to $10k/month with VP+Finance approval; permanent increases require Head of Finance sign-off + documented business case. All exceptions default to 30 days unless extended.

sarah_pm: For roadmap planning, how should PMs annotate recurring infra costs vs one-time capex in PRDs?

maria: Put a line item in the PRD: expected recurring monthly run-rate + any upfront commit. If you'd like FP&A to estimate amortized capex impact, tag finance (cc: @vp_finance). Also include an internal unit-econ row if proposing Dedicated reservations.

harper: Vendor onboarding question: is there a checklist so teams know which legal/infosec items are required? Our vendor is asking for an onboarding timeline.

procurement-bot: Vendor checklist summary: 1) intake form submission, 2) basic SOW + contact, 3) security questionnaire (if required), 4) PO or approved payment path, 5) payment terms negotiation. Typical lead time 7-21 business days depending on security/legal.

noah: If procurement needs faster turnaround for a production issue, what do we mark on the form?

maria: Use the procurement intake and mark "prod-impact" and "expedite". Also email finance-ops@redwood.com with the ticket link. Expedited requests get triaged within 24 business hours; temporary credits or virtual cards may be issued for up to 60-90 days pending full review.

vp_finance: Runway note: baseline planning target remains ~18 months. We are running sensitivity scenarios and will publish conservative/base/optimistic dashboards next week. If teams have high near-term vendor spend, flag it so FP&A can include it in short-term cash forecasts.

sarah_pm: Any change to procurement SLA for SOW/legal reviews? Last month we had a 2-week delay.

maria: We're updating SLA: intake triage within 2 business days, standard SOW review 7-10 business days, complex security reviews longer. For prod-impact tickets use "expedite" and mention the incident ID.

harper: One more: if a vendor only accepts card payments and amount >$5k, is there a preference?

maria: Prefer invoice routing. If card is required, procurement can generate a virtual card up to $15k with manager + finance approval for a one-time payment. Anything >$15k should be routed to invoice/PO and procurement will negotiate payment terms.

finance-bot: New ticket created: PROC-478 - "One-pager: p-card/PO/prepay decision matrix" (assigned to procurement).

harper: Thanks  can someone post the one-pager link when ready? Prefer a tiny flowchart + two example scenarios.

maria: Will do  target EOD Wed. I'll post the link here and @harper once live. :memo:
